subjects.description: Cars and a delivery truck parked and driving along a city street, kept at their exact positions and sizes
subjects.appearance_details: Ordinary modern sedans, SUVs and vans in realistic paint, glass and tyres; a glossy red compact sedan among them
subjects.location: On the road and along the kerb

background_setting: A real urban avenue on an overcast day. Tall modern office towers and brick low-rise buildings with shopfronts on one side; a wide sidewalk with a row of large leafy trees on the other. A multi-lane asphalt road with a double yellow centre line, white dashed lane markings and a solid white edge line; concrete kerbs; street lamps and road signs along the sidewalk.

lighting.direction: Diffuse ambient light from a uniformly grey sky
lighting.shadows: Minimal, soft shadows beneath vehicles and trees

aesthetics.composition: Fixed camera rigidly mounted on a moving car; the road, kerb and buildings sweep past according to the camera's heading
aesthetics.color_palette: Grey asphalt, white and yellow road markings, muted building facades, green foliage, pale grey sky
aesthetics.visual_quality: Sharp, high-detail, natural photographic realism with no cartoon or rendered look

cinematography.camera_motion: Rigidly attached to a car moving forward at a steady speed
cinematography.camera_angle: Eye-level, mounted on the car body

context: Footage from a camera rigidly mounted on a car driving at a steady speed along a city avenue. Preserve the camera viewpoint and heading, the road geometry, the lane markings, and the position, size and motion of every vehicle exactly; do not add or remove vehicles, signs, poles or obstacles.

actions.description: The car drives forward at a constant speed; the street scene passes by smoothly in the direction the camera faces.

segments.description: Continuous vehicle-camera view along an overcast city avenue with office towers and a tree-lined sidewalk.

temporal_caption: From 0:00 to 0:04, a car-mounted camera moves steadily along a multi-lane city avenue on an overcast day, with tall buildings and a row of trees passing by.
audio_description: Ambient city traffic, tyre noise on asphalt, a low engine hum.
